tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Live search of Booking.com, Vrbo and Expedia (hotel rooms) for the dates and party, verified against the map. Returns up to three picks (best overall, best value, closest) with receipts and tracked openUrl links. Takes 30 to 90 seconds; returns status 'running' with a searchId if it is not done with

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: The card for a search by searchId: finished picks with receipts, or its running status. Free and instant. Use it to finish a search_stays call that returned 'running', or to read a shared stay (https://stayotter.com/stay/s_…).

tools.name: city_picks
tools.description: Instant and free: the latest finished standard search for one of the covered cities (a two-adult stay about a month out, refreshed daily). Covered: Austin, Lisbon, Kyoto, Mexico City, New York, Paris, Barcelona, Montreal, San Diego, Edinburgh, Honolulu, London, South Lake Tahoe, Sedona, Holbox, Niag

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Top-rated things to do on Viator for a search's spot and dates (what the trip is for first, the city's best otherwise), with a second place to look when the row is thin. Pass a searchId from search_stays or city_picks; intent overrides the search's own.

tools.name: set_alert
tools.description: Starts the otter's daily re-run of a finished search, emailing the key's account when a verified pick drops 5% or $50 or the cheapest pick disappears. Needs a key (stayotter.com/connect); the first alert is free with an account, more are Pro.

tools.description: Reads one place the traveller found themselves into the receipts a pick carries: where it is, whether the street is quiet or lively, bars, cafés and restaurants within a ten-minute walk, the distance to a spot they name and, with dates, the lowest total and the lowest they can still cancel, each rea

tools.name: watch_booking
tools.description: For a stay already booked with free cancellation: pass the confirmation email's text. The otter keeps five facts (property, dates, total paid, deadline, where it was booked), discards the rest (no names, confirmation numbers or card details), reads the property's rate every morning and emails the ac

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_booking · Public sink: watch_booking · Destructive: set_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_booking · Public sink: watch_booking · Destructive: set_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
